name: Cleancell
_note: Added 2026-09-17 for the live Amperage Capital deal (56 units). orgId is cleancell.us — the domain of robert.bucher@cleancell.us, which is ALSO their website (verified 2026-09-17: resolves, HTTP 200, MX smtp.google.com, so it is a real Workspace domain and passes the work-email gate in api/_lib/public-domains.js). ⚠ THE LIVE RECORD IS UNDER THE WRONG KEY AND THIS FILE IS THE CORRECTION. Thomas created omega_orgs/cleancellusa.com by hand on 2026-09-16 with a paid tier and addons already set. cleancellusa.com does NOT EXIST — NXDOMAIN, checked 2026-09-17. Because orgId IS the email domain, that account is reachable only by someone mailing from @cleancellusa.com, so nobody at Clean Cell can sign in to it and none of what was bought is reachable. tier/addons/dates here are copied from that record rather than invented, so a seed run reproduces what he decided instead of repricing a paying account to a trial. The invoice amount is deliberately NOT in this file: plan() in scripts/seed-omega-orgs.js does not read it, and a contract value does not belong in the repo. The migration itself (create cleancell.us, repoint tenant_public/cleancell.clearskyomega.com, FLAG the old record without deleting it — CLAUDE.md, never delete in a migration) is a Firestore write and is NOT done by this file. NAME — three spellings are in play. Thomas's record says 'Cleancell', which is what this file now matches so a seed does not rename his account; cleancell.us calls itself 'Clean Cell US'; clearsky-cost-estimator.html carries a battery brand { key: 'cleancells', name: 'Clean Cells' }. That estimator entry is a BRAND in a dropdown, not a tenant, and was deliberately left alone — renaming a brand key silently rewrites saved estimates. RECEIVER VS ORIGINATOR. receivesFullBom is false because Clean Cell is the MIRROR of FENECON: Fenecon is an OEM that RECEIVES quote requests, Clean Cell is an originator that SENDS an opportunity out. Read that carefully — false is also the default for every tenant, so it does not positively say 'originator', and there is no field that does: plan() in scripts/seed-omega-orgs.js copies a fixed key list, so an invented key never reaches Firestore. Originator identity is recorded PER DEAL by omega-originator.js as originatorOrgId. requiredTools pins the financing marketplace, which is this deal's route to Amperage. HOSTNAME: cleancell.clearskyomega.com does not resolve — there is no wildcard DNS for *.clearskyomega.com, and budderfly./eastwestenergy./walters. are the same. Until it is attached in Vercel they sign in on silmarillion.clearskyomega.com, an OPEN_HOST that resolves the workspace from the email domain. BATTERY SIZER: pinned in requiredTools 2026-09-20. Clean Cell sells battery systems, so the sizer is the tool that generates the opportunity this workspace exists to route; leaving it to the tier meant it could be removed from the dashboard by any member. The tier (deluxe) and the 'engineering' addon already satisfy the gate in api/bess-size.js and api/bess-design.js, so pinning it changes what is VISIBLE, not what is PERMITTED — the gate is still the serverless function, never the dashboard. Note requiredTools is copied into tenant_public by scripts/seed-omega-orgs.js, so this only takes effect on the next seed run; it is not live until then, and neither is the orgId correction described above.
